title: feat(objectql): an object extension's fieldPatches relabels the vendor field on every read, refused at install and os validate when it names nothing (#28565)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XR1KAQEJUPapgHT2dsHnwQx)_

Fixes #28565

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up #28730

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：对象扩展的「字段显示补丁」（`objectExtensions[].fieldPatches`，上一版只声明未生效）现在真的生效了：引擎注册扩展时带上它，注册表合并（`mergeObjectDefinitions`）在字段合并之后把白名单里的 label、description、帮助文字、占位符和选项 label 写到厂商字段上；字段类型、必填、选项取值不变。补丁指向目标对象没有的字段或选项值时，在市场安装口和 `os validate` 拒绝；启动时只记一次日志、不拦启动。
- **为什么改**：HotCRM 的 "Industry" 要在每个表单、列表和 API 读取里显示成 "Sector"，而字段本身仍归厂商，厂商升级照样进来。指向不存在字段的补丁以前会悄悄什么都不做。
- **风险与回滚**：只影响写了 `fieldPatches` 的扩展；没写的扩展合并结果逐字节不变。租户自己改过的文字照旧优先（ADR-0029 D9.2a），两个扩展冲突时 priority 高者胜。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `patchedField` / `applyFieldPatches` 与 `tenantPatchedDisplayKeys`（合并与让位）；② `packages/metadata-core/src/extension-field-patch-targets.ts`（三处共用的目标检查）；③ `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 新增的 2e 步。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-extension-field-patches.test.ts`，预期 9 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Carry** — `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`: the manifest loop's `extDef` carries `fieldPatches` beside `fields`, so the `'extend'` registration hands the slot to the registry. Re-measured at `2678600d`: still the only `'extend'` registration in `objectql`, `metadata-protocol` and `runtime` (`git grep "'extend'"`, one call site, `engine.ts:8996`).
- **Apply** — `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`:
  - `mergeObjectDefinitions` gains one step after the scalar overrides: `applyFieldPatches` writes each `BASE_FIELD_DISPLAY_WHITELIST.field` key onto the named field and each `BASE_FIELD_DISPLAY_WHITELIST.option` key onto the option whose stored `value` the patch names. Keys are read from the constant, so a widened whitelist widens the merge. The type of the slot is the spec's own (`ObjectExtensionParsed['fieldPatches']`); there is no second patch shape.
  - D9.2a yield: `tenantPatchedDisplayKeys` computes, once over the fold's base, which patched field/option keys the tenant authored away from the packaged owner's value, with the same two "no opinion" edges as `tenantAuthoredScalars` (no owner; base IS the owner by reference). The comparison is `scalarOverridesPackagedBase` itself, called through a one-line adapter because its exported key union names only the object scalars and `message`.
  - Priority: the fold already applies contributors in ascending `priority`, so the higher one writes last, exactly as for `label`.
  - Boot: `reportFieldPatchMisses` names, once per object/package/field/option, a patch the fold could not apply, at `warn`, worded as the observed state. Never a refusal: the fold runs on every read while a boot is still registering (AGENTS.md *Startup registry reads*), and the patch applies on the next read once the field arrives.
  - `subtractExtenderContributions` is untouched: patches are idempotent over an already-folded base (the base carries the patched text, reads as authored, and the patch yields to the same value), the way the scalars are. Pinned by the "idempotent over a folded body" assertion.
- **By-name and layered reads** — no edit. `protocol-object-extender-fold.ts` already calls `registry.foldObjectExtendersOnto`, which runs `foldExtendersOntoDefinition` → `mergeObjectDefinitions`, the one apply implementation (measured; the order's assumption holds). The code layer (`getArtifactItem('object')` → `resolveOwnerLayer`) goes through the same fold.
- **Target check** — `packages/metadata-core/src/extension-field-patch-targets.ts` (new): `fieldPatchTargetMisses` (one extension against one target), `fieldPatchTargetRefusals` (a manifest's `objectExtensions`, located) and `fieldPatchTargetRefusalMessage`. Misses: a field the target lacks, an option value its field lacks, and an option patch on a picklist-bound field (its options are written over the field after the fold, so an option patch there could never be served). `metadata-core` is the one package all three readers already depend on. One call line each:
  - `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts#handleInstall`, new step **2e**, right after N-09's override write gate (2d) and before the hot-register (3): `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, every refusal in `error.details.refusals`, nothing registered, written or synced. Targets: one the same artifact delivers, else the registry's resolved object.
  - `packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts`, new step **3a-iv** after the override gate, over `packages/cli/src/utils/field-patch-targets.ts` (the walk: objects across the composed stack and every `packages[]` entry).
  - the registry fold's boot log (above).
- **Marker flip** — `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`: `fieldPatches`' `.describe()` drops `[EXPERIMENTAL — not enforced]` and cites `mergeObjectDefinitions`; its TSDoc, the `@example` comment and the guidance code comment follow. No liveness ledger row exists for the slot (`grep -l ObjectExtension packages/spec/liveness/*.json`: none). `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx` regenerated (`gen:docs`, the one artifact `check:generated` named stale). The spec test that pinned the marker now pins its absence.
- **Docs** — `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx`: `fieldPatches` in the contribution table, a "Relabelling a vendor field" section, and the D9.2a callout extended.
- `packages/cli/test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts`: the new validate gate is classified in `VALIDATE_ONLY_GATES` with its reason (the closed roster requires it); the build-side gap is reported below.
- `.changeset/28565-field-patch-applied.md`: minor on `objectql`, `metadata-core`, `cloud-connection`, `cli` and `spec` (the kind is `semantic`; each package's `files[]` ships `dist`, which carries the change after a build).

## Acceptance notes

- **The protocol install primitive is not a door a patch can reach.** The order rules a call line at `protocol-package-install.ts#installPackage`; measured, its manifest is parsed by `PackageInstallManifestSchema` (strict `ManifestSchema`), which refuses `objectExtensions` as an unknown key before anything else runs: `PackageInstallManifestSchema.safeParse({ id: 'com.acme.ext', name: 'E', type: 'app', version: '1.0.0', objectExtensions: [...] })` → `false`, "Unrecognized key(s) on this package manifest: `objectExtensions`" (spec dist built from `2678600d`). A call line there could never fire and could not be ablated, so none was written. The only install door that delivers an extension today is `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` (including `os package install <file>`, which posts there); the card's "Not here" names the future runtime write door for an `object_extension` item (#28574).
- **`os build` does not run the target check.** It still emits an artifact the install door then refuses; recorded as the `VALIDATE_ONLY_GATES` row. Wiring it into `compile.ts` is outside the card's three doors.
- **Option patches on picklist-bound fields are refused**, not applied: the served options of such a field are the picklist's, written after the fold (`finishServedObject`), so an option label patched in the fold would be overwritten on every read.
- **`ObjectExtensionSchema.guidance.actions`** still reads "the merge carries `fields`, `label`, `pluralLabel`, `description`, `validations` and `indexes` only". It is a refusal sentence about `actions`, so it is left as is under ruling 3 (only the slot's marker moves in `packages/spec`); it now omits `fieldPatches` from that list.
- **Declaration lines** are the claim's, copied. The install and validate refusals are new refusals of a key that was declared `[EXPERIMENTAL — not enforced]`; the ruling records the kind as `semantic`.
- #28564 (the `__c` judge at the same doors) has not landed at the time of this PR; whichever lands second sits its call line beside the other's.

## Verification

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-extension-field-patches.test.ts` — 9/9 at head `043407e6`; 8 red with `registry.ts` and `engine.ts` restored to `2678600d` (the ninth is the no-patch control).
